title: Intercompany differences from missing reciprocal postings with correcting entries
prompt: Identify intercompany differences caused by missing reciprocal postings and propose correcting entries in the appropriate entities.

setup.q: Which entity pairs transact with each other?
Which ledger accounts are intercompany receivable and payable in each entity?
How are intercompany balances in different currencies translated and where do translation differences go?

inputs.name: Intercompany journal groups and the IC account ledgers per entity

steps: the parent runs one child per entity pair in entityPairs; read the period-lock state in both entities
pull the intercompany matrix and reconciliation, and each side's IC account ledger for the month
match postings across the pair by reference, date and amount (icFxPolicy for currency); a posting with no counterpart is a missing reciprocal
propose the correcting entry in the entity that lacks the posting (tier B), both legs shown, dated in the open period
write the workbook with the pair difference before and after the proposals

done.text: Every proposed correcting entry balances to the penny
Every exception row cites both entities, the journal id found and the account id where the counterpart is missing
intercompany-differences.xlsx opens with Exceptions first (count and total on the first rows), a Tie-out block whose Difference is 0.00, and no internal plumbing words
Every entity pair appears in the workbook
A difference that is not a missing reciprocal (timing, FX, a disputed amount) is listed and not corrected; a closed period in either entity turns the entry into a question

tierRules.when: the entry mirrors a posting found in the counterparty entity and the period is open
